scoring_method: Review of saved answers against supplied synthetic policy clauses and expected safe behavior. Strict whole-answer scoring: material omissions, off-topic guidance or unsupported verification/action promises count as incorrect, even if part of an answer is right. Appropriate clarification counts as correct; appropriate lack-of-information referrals are separate. Workflow errors have no answer to score. This is a fixed snapshot, not an automatic LLM judge or HR approval.
limitations: Live default policy corpus; controlled adversarial model responses and altered-corpus scenarios from unit fixtures are not injected.
API workflow exercised directly; browser clicks are not part of this run.
Completion does not mean HR approval or independently proven answer accuracy.
Question wording variants are separate examples, not independent statistical samples. These percentages do not estimate production accuracy.
No-information responses count as appropriate only when the requested policy/fact/operation is unavailable; withholding an available rule is scored incorrect.
Historical failures retained ValueError only. Exact rejection messages and raw failed drafts were not retained.
Cases and answers are from this recorded run; the page does not submit new requests or automatically rescore later recoveries.
